verdict.rationale: Datadog Watchdog is documented as an AI-powered engine that auto-detects anomalies, outliers, and performance issues without manual threshold-setting, directly matching the story, and Monitors docs support anomaly-detection alert types. Community discussion raises outlier detection as a known Datadog strength but offers no first-hand validation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of Watchdog's detection accuracy, specifics on false-positive rates or tuning workflow.
